evidence_slice: Folkestone & Hythe District Council's official Otterpool Park outline-planning page identifies application Y19/0257/FH, received 28 February 2019 and updated from March 2022, and records the Planning and Licensing Committee resolution on 4 April 2023 to grant subject to planning conditions and satisfactory s106 agreement(s). The council's application guidance states the application proposes up to 8,500 homes. On 23 March 2026 the council reported a renewed collaboration agreement with Homes England, focused on securing planning permission for the current 8,500-home scheme through December 2026.
